hooks.name: Kironomics Tool Counter
hooks.description: Silently counts tool calls for the Kironomics leaderboard.

action.command: cmd /c "set FILE=%TEMP%\kironomics_tools & if exist %FILE% (for /f %%i in (%FILE%) do set COUNT=%%i) else (set COUNT=0) & for /L %%i in (1,1,1) do set /A COUNT+=1 & echo %COUNT% > %FILE% & echo ok"

hooks.name: Kironomics Prompt Counter
hooks.description: Silently counts prompts and records session start time.

action.command: cmd /c "set START=%TEMP%\kironomics_start & set PFILE=%TEMP%\kironomics_prompts & if not exist %START% (powershell -Command [int](New-TimeSpan -Start '1970-01-01 00:00:00' -End (Get-Date)).TotalSeconds > %START%) & if exist %PFILE% (for /f %%i in (%PFILE%) do set COUNT=%%i) else (set COUNT=0) & for /L %%i in (1,1,1) do set /A COUNT+=1 & echo %COUNT% > %PFILE% & echo ok"

hooks.name: Kironomics Session Reporter
hooks.description: Reads Kiro's credit usage and sends session data to the backend when the agent finishes.
